name: Clarity actual-frame AVC decoder probe
status: Approved parked test completed 2026-09-25; 28/30 frames from two concurrent NVIDIA decoders; APK removed and baseline restored
question: Can the selected AVC codec decode one or two concurrent 800x480 15fps H.264 streams to actual output buffers?
test_limit: A two-decoder success does not prove CarPlay receiver multi-display negotiation or coexistence with the factory CarPlay decoder.
vehicle_changes_if_later_approved: Install one APK in /data/app and create its ordinary app data
Reserve and release one or two AVC decoder instances for at most seven seconds after a button tap
Write ordinary Android logcat entries under ClarityDecoderProbe
rollback_if_later_approved: Force-stop and uninstall org.claritylab.decoderprobe, verify package removal, and verify baseline center CarPlay/voice after normal session restart.
